## func [ParseRoomID](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/web/helpers/helpers.go#L57>)

```go
func ParseRoomID(r *http.Request) (int, error)
```

ParseRoomID parses the RoomID from the request URL\. It will return an error and zero if no valid roomID was found in URL or if the string conversion failed\.
